title: Intake Horizon & Scope Tiling: fast-aggregation for enterprise Sales/CS asks
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Sales and CS submit high-volume, heterogeneous enterprise feature requests (non-bug) that are taking too long to summarize and prioritize. Current first-pass scoping is inconsistent across reps and leads to duplicated work, missed constraints (security, private deployment), and slow signal-to-product.

Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'horizon and scope tiling' process that aggregates bundles of related enterprise asks every 48–72 hours, produces a 1-page synthesis per tile, and outputs a deterministic prioritization score for PM review. This should reduce average time-to-first-scope from ~7 days to <48 hours and improve handoff quality to Eng/Design.

Why now: Rising enterprise volume in EMEA/APAC and Dedicated/Private inquiries have increased triage load. We need a pragmatic process + templates + tooling to avoid manual, ad-hoc triage that blocks Dedicated and Private renewals.
goals: Define 'tile' heuristic: cluster by customer need, product surface, and regulatory signal
Ship a 1-page synthesis template for reps to populate (summary, customers, ask, acceptance, blockers)
Implement initial scoring rubric (value, feasibility, risk, revenue horizon) and automation hints
Pilot process with 3 AE/CS teams for 2 sprints and measure time-to-first-scope reduction
acceptance_criteria: Tile heuristic documented and agreed by PM + 2 AE leads
Synthesis template available in Confluence and a Drive copy linked to in-line in the CS intake form
Automated clustering job (manual-runable) groups >60% of incoming asks into tiles with >1 ask each
Pilot reduces median time-to-first-scope to <=48 hours for pilot accounts
Clear next-step owner (PM/SE/Eng) assigned for each tile and tracked in Linear
proposed_solution: Create a short-form synthesis template (1 page) and an intake checkbox matrix to capture critical constraints (Dedicated, Private, PII, SLA needs)
Define tile rules: cluster by product area (API/Console/Dedicated/Private), account cohort, and urgency flag from AE
Build a lightweight Google Drive + Confluence workflow: reps fill a standardized form which feeds a shared 'tile inbox' doc maintained by PMs
Run a weekly automated clusterer (initially based on keyword matching + account tags) and allow manual merge/split by PM
Score tiles by a 4-factor rubric (customer impact, short-term revenue, technical feasibility, security/compliance risk) producing a deterministic score
tradeoffs_considered: Automation vs human judgment: aggressive automation reduces latency but risks incorrect clusters; plan is semi-automated clustering with PM review
Strict templating vs rep flexibility: strict template improves data quality but adds friction during capture; mitigate with a short checklist and optional freeform notes
Fast scoring vs deep discovery: prioritize fast first-pass scoring to reduce cycle time; deeper discovery reserved for top N tiles each sprint
